name: Schleitheimia
sum: Schleitheimia is a sauropodiform sauropodomorph from the Norian Klettgau Formation of Switzerland, named for Schleitheim.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: PIMUZ A/III 550, from the Gruhalde Member; other bones from the locality are paratypes.
